questions.question: How much does a shared Daclify DAO cost for 50 members?
questions.title: Shared hosting and graduated member capacity
questions.answer: For a shared Daclify DAO with 50 total members, the cost is $40. This covers the first 10 free slots plus 40 paid slots (slots 11 through 50), each paid slot costing 100 USD cents per month.

questions.question: How do I configure Telegram login for Daclify?
questions.title: Configure external services
questions.answer:
To configure Telegram website login for Daclify, follow these steps:

1. Register your real HTTPS frontend URL and the exact API callback URL in BotFather Login Widget.

2. On the backend, set these environment variables together:
   - TELEGRAM_OIDC_CLIENT_ID
   - TELEGRAM_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET
   - TELEGRAM_OIDC_REDIRECT_URI

   The callback path must be exactly: /v1/sign-in/telegram/oidc/callback

3. Use RS256 as the signing algorithm.

4. Restart the API server after setting these variables.

Notes:
- The bot token is separate from the OIDC client secret.
- OIDC pairing and Mini App launch setup are separate steps.
- Do not share secrets in support chat.
- Test a real Telegram client before qualification.

This setup enables Telegram OIDC login with state, nonce, PKCE, and verified JWKS signatures for secure authentication.

questions.question: How do I enable the Daclify docs bot in a Telegram group?
questions.title: Daclify documentation assistant and Telegram group support
questions.answer:
To enable the Daclify docs bot in a Telegram group, follow these steps from the guide:

1. Set these environment variables in your backend:
   - `TELEGRAM_DOCS_ENABLED=true`
   - `TELEGRAM_DOCS_GROUP_IDS` as a JSON array of approved negative chat ID strings for your groups
   - `TELEGRAM_DOCS_WEBHOOK_SECRET` as a random URL-safe secret of at least 32 characters
   - `TELEGRAM_DOCS_WEBHOOK_URL` as the HTTPS API URL ending with `/v1/docs/telegram/webhook`
   - Also set `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` and `TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME` (without the @)
   - Set `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` and `FRONTEND_ORIGIN` as required

2. Keep the bot as a regular member of the Telegram group with BotFather privacy mode enabled.

3. Restart the API backend after setting these variables.

4. Register the webhook by running:
   ```
   npm run telegram:docs:setup -- --confirm
   ```
   with the correct `DACLIFY_ENV_FILE`. This command checks membership, privacy, and webhook conflicts before enabling.

5. In the approved Telegram group, users can then use:
   ```
   /docs@your_bot_username
   ```
   followed by their Daclify question to interact with the bot.

This setup enables the Daclify docs bot to answer questions in your Telegram group.

questions.question: How do I enable the Daclify docs bot in a Telegram group?
questions.title: Daclify documentation assistant and Telegram group support
questions.answer:
Telegram group chat is separate from Telegram login. To enable the Daclify docs bot:

1. In the backend environment, set:
   - TELEGRAM_DOCS_ENABLED=true
   - TELEGRAM_DOCS_GROUP_IDS to a JSON array of approved negative chat ID strings
   - TELEGRAM_DOCS_WEBHOOK_SECRET to a random URL-safe secret of at least 32 characters
   - TELEGRAM_DOCS_WEBHOOK_URL to your HTTPS API URL ending in /v1/docs/telegram/webhook
   - TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME (without @)
   - OPENROUTER_API_KEY and the real FRONTEND_ORIGIN

2. Keep the bot a regular group member and leave BotFather privacy mode enabled.

3. Restart the API. With the correct DACLIFY_ENV_FILE, run:
   npm run telegram:docs:setup -- --confirm
   The read-only setup command without --confirm checks membership, privacy settings and webhook conflicts first.

4. In an approved group, ask with /docs@your_bot_username followed by your Daclify question. /docs also works when Telegram delivers it to the bot. Reply to a bot answer to ask a follow-up.

Do not send passwords, private keys, recovery kits or provider secrets.

questions.question: ¿Cómo recupero mis claves de Daclify?
questions.title: Recover keys and blockchain access
questions.answer:
Tus claves privadas de firma y descifrado se guardan cifradas en la bóveda local de este navegador y en el kit de recuperación descargado. Para recuperarlas, restaura el kit original y confirma con tu wallet. Necesitas también la credencial de recuperación, que protege el kit por separado de la contraseña de la bóveda.

Si perdiste el servidor o la base de datos, conecta una wallet Telos Zero o una cuenta EOA compatible con Telos EVM y firma un desafío nuevo en el navegador. Esto puede reconstruir el acceso del servicio asociado a tu wallet, pero no recupera las claves de la bóveda por sí solo: para vincularlas al perfil recuperado necesitas el kit original y demostrar que controlas esas claves.

Si perdiste el kit o la credencial de recuperación, Daclify no puede recrear las claves. Una clave nueva sirve para nuevos DAOs, pero no descifra documentos antiguos. Guarda el kit cifrado y la credencial por separado, y conserva copias independientes de los archivos de IPFS.

questions.question: Czy prywatne dokumenty DAO w Daclify są zaszyfrowane?
questions.title: What encryption protects
questions.answer:
Tak. Prywatne dokumenty DAO są szyfrowane w przeglądarce, zanim trafią do Pinata lub publicznej sieci IPFS. Szyfrowanie dokumentów i podpisywanie używają oddzielnych kluczy.

Pamiętaj, że aktywność członkostwa i głosowania, wyniki, salda, terminy oraz skróty treści pozostają widoczne w publicznym blockchainie.
